figures.title: Complete the lesson; keep the decision human
figures.desc: The six-step lesson flow, from the live Direction Brief through the exercise, logging, independent evidence review, measurement, reflection, and transfer.
figures.caption: Read left to right: measurement follows independent review; transfer follows measurement.
figures.transcript: One: Direction Brief in Operator — Direction & Log. Two: lesson exercise in a build chat. Three: Operator Log plus lesson-outcome check in Direction & Log. Four: independent evidence review in a new chat every lesson. Five: Measurement Spine—brief accuracy, overclaim, elapsed time, and lesson reflection. Six: Transfer plan in Operator — Transfer 30-60-90.
